newsitem.title: UK: India Debt Fund Ltd sets preference shares. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: India Debt Fund Ltd sets preference shares. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]

text.p: India Debt Fund Ltd has launched up to $150 million of redeemable participating preference shares, placing agent Nomura International Plc said on Monday.
The issue has a subscription price of $10.30 per share which includes a placement commission of 30 cents.
There is a minimum subscription of $100,000 (corrects from "100,000 shares"), and the issue will be listed in London with English law applying.
The payment date is July 9, 1997 and there is a 15 perecent over-allottment option.
Sales limits include the U.S. UK, India, Japan, Germany, Switzerland, Hong Kong, France and Singapore. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
